detail: ticket 2: first merge failed, 1 merge failure(s), 13 steps; recall showed 5 fact(s)

memories_after: [Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) In the docs project, verify a deliverable's raw first bytes (e.g. Format-Hex or [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes) before submitting a file with an exact-string header, since Get-Content hides BOM problems.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-2 {"os":"windows","product":"powershell","vendor":"microsoft"}) PowerShell's Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a UTF-8 BOM, so the first line does not match an exact-string header check and the pre-merge check fails; write such files BOM-free (utf8NoBOM or [IO.File]::WriteAllText with UTF8Encoding($false)).

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When creating or editing a team document in the docs project's deliverables/ or reports/, put the exact 'Owner: docs-team' line first before submitting; otherwise the pre-merge check fails and the work is rejected, even if acceptance criteria pass and review approves.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) The docs project's ticket worktrees run on Windows, so file content is verified with PowerShell Get-Content rather than shell tools like cat.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project's pre-merge check fails when a deliverables/ or reports/ document's first line is not the required owner line.
[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document in deliverables/ or reports/ must name its owning team on its first line, exactly 'Owner: docs-team'.
